notes:
- Real Prisma 5.22.0 migrate output. Includes the `Applying migration`
  banner, the migrations/ tree, the "in sync" line, and a tail
  `✔ Generated Prisma Client` summary triggered by the implicit
  generate-after-migrate flow.
- A "Update available 5.22.0 -> 7.8.0" 8-line ASCII box appears at the
  end. The migrate filter drops it because it matches none of the
  keep-rules (migration / applied / sync / generated / error).
- ANSI cursor-control sequences (`\x1b[2K\x1b[1A`) are present on the
  `Running generate…` lines and are stripped by the engine's strip_ansi.
